description: Search the free Iconaut icon set (MIT) by name, keyword or meaning, e.g. "settings", "arrow left", "delete", "notification". Returns icon names ranked by relevance, with their category, the styles each comes in (line, solid, duo) and the React component names. Call this before using an icon name you have not looked up: guessed names often do not exist. Leave query empty and pass a category to list that category.

category.description: Only icons in this category id (see list_categories).

query.description: Words to search for. Empty lists everything (narrow it with category).

style.description: Only icons that come in this style. Marks like arrows and check have no duo.

name: search_icons
title: Search Iconaut icons
